content.stem: (audio) What will the client be asked to do?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Mr. Kimura, you have a call from a client.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Could you ask her to hold for a minute?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Sure. Should I transfer the call to your desk?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Yes, please. I’ll be ready in a moment.

content.rationale: He asks her to hold for a minute.
